info.name: Bike Log API
info.description: Backend API for the Bike Log app (Express + TypeScript + Mongoose). Auth via JWT Bearer token — run Auth > Login first (after Auth > Register once), which auto-captures {{token}}. Then run Bikes > Create Bike, Maintenance Types > Create Maintenance Type, and Engine Oil Types > Create Engine Oil Type to auto-capture the ids the rest of the collection chains off of. See dummy-data.md in this folder for the full field reference.

request.description: Creates a new user. Response never includes the password hash. If the email already exists, returns 409 Conflict.

Logs in and returns a JWT at the top-level `token` field (not under `data`). The test script below saves it into the `token` collection variable automatically, so every other request in this collection (which use Bearer {{token}}) will work right after this runs.
`owner` is taken from the JWT, never send it. `currentOdometer` here seeds the bike's immutable `initialOdometer` too; it's optional (defaults to 0).
All fields optional. `owner` and `currentOdometer` are silently stripped server-side even if you send them here.
Soft delete. Run this LAST if at all — every other folder below depends on {{bikeId}} still being usable.

Never send `totalCost` — it's always server-computed as litersAdded * pricePerLiter and any client value is discarded. Response shape is `data.fuelLog` (+ `data.mileageRecordClosed` if isFullTank closed a period).

body.raw:
{
  "odometerReading": 1550,
  "litersAdded": 8.5,
  "isFullTank": true,
  "pricePerLiter": 125.5,
  "fuelStation": "Padma Filling Station",
  "date": "2026-07-01",
  "notes": "Full tank before highway trip"
}

request.description: Supports pagination (page/limit), sort, and field filters via QueryBuilder. `bike`/`isDeleted` query keys are ignored server-side (IDOR hardening) even if you set them.
Fails with 409 if this fuel log was already closed into a mileage record. `totalCost` is recomputed server-side whenever litersAdded/pricePerLiter change; a client-sent totalCost is dropped.
multipart/form-data, field name `image`, image files only (5MB max). Replacing an existing receiptImage deletes the old Cloudinary asset first.
No write endpoints exist for this module — records are auto-created when a full-tank fuel log closes a period.
targetMonth is required, format YYYY-MM.
targetYear is required, format YYYY.
months is optional (default 3, range 1-24). Returns a rolling window of the last N months ending at the current month, not calendar-year-bound.

Use a name distinct from the 8 seeded types (Engine Oil, Chain Lube, Tire Change, Brake Pads, General Service, Insurance, Registration/Tax, Other) to avoid confusion with catalog data from `yarn seed:maintenance-types`.
Run `yarn seed:maintenance-types` once against your DB first if this comes back empty.
Use a name distinct from the 3 seeded types (Mineral, Semi-Synthetic, Synthetic) to avoid confusion with catalog data from `yarn seed:engine-oil-types`.
Run `yarn seed:engine-oil-types` once against your DB first if this comes back empty.

Run 'Create Maintenance Type' and 'Create Engine Oil Type' first so {{maintenanceTypeId}}/{{engineOilTypeId}} are populated (or replace with real ids from the List requests, e.g. a seeded catalog id). `oilType` is optional. Never send `nextDueOdometer` — it's computed server-side from odometerReading + intervalKmUsed.
multipart/form-data, field name `image`, image files only (5MB max). Replacing an existing serviceImage deletes the old Cloudinary asset first.
Computed on-read by comparing the bike's currentOdometer / today's date against each maintenance type's latest nextDueOdometer / nextDueDate. No body or query params.
period must be exactly one of month/year/lifetime, or the request 400s.
months is optional (default 3, range 1-24). Returns a rolling window of the last N months ending at the current month, not calendar-year-bound.

multipart/form-data, field name `image`, image files only (5MB max). {{bikeAccessoryId}} isn't auto-captured yet (no Create Bike Accessory request in this collection) — paste in a real accessory _id from POST/GET .../bikes/{{bikeId}}/accessories. Replacing an existing productImage deletes the old Cloudinary asset first.

multipart/form-data, field name `images` (repeat the key for multiple files, up to 5 per request), image files only (5MB max each). {{bikeIssueId}} isn't auto-captured yet (no Create Bike Issue request in this collection) — paste in a real issue _id from POST/GET .../bikes/{{bikeId}}/issues. Appends to the issue's existing images array — does not replace it.
Removes a single image by its own subdocument _id (captured automatically by Add Bike Issue Images, or paste one from the issue's images array manually).

Cached by log count, not TTL. First call for a bike with data generates and caches; repeat calls with no new logs return the cached value with no AI call. A bike with zero logs returns a fixed 'no data yet' message with generated: false, no AI call made.
Cached by fuel-log count, not TTL. Same shape as Spending Insight.

Stateless per request — resend the full message history each call. `messages` must be non-empty; any message with role "system" is rejected with 400 (the system prompt is always server-constructed from real bike data). Context is bounded to the 20 most recent fuel logs + 20 most recent maintenance logs plus lifetime spending totals.
